# Match runtime/src/CMakeLists.txt's own EXPORT_SET/COMPONENT (not calling
# iree_setup_c_src_root() again here, which would also reset the package-name
# root this repo's own root CMakeLists.txt already established). Needed so
# PUBLIC libraries under here (e.g. DriverModuleLib) are members of the same
# "Runtime" install(EXPORT ...) set as the IREE targets that depend on them
# (e.g. iree::hal::drivers::drivers) -- required for CMake's export-set
# validation at generate time even when nothing ever runs `cmake --install`.
set(IREE_INSTALL_LIBRARY_TARGETS_DEFAULT_EXPORT_SET "Runtime")
set(IREE_INSTALL_LIBRARY_TARGETS_DEFAULT_COMPONENT "IREEDevLibraries-Runtime")

iree_add_all_subdirs()
